extracted.intended_audience: legal practitioners, regulatory staff, agency personnel, and members of the public seeking Title 15 (Commerce and Foreign Trade) regulations
extracted.subtask_description: An index/landing page for Title 15 of the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (Commerce and Foreign Trade) that lists parts/chapters and provides site-level guidance about the eCFR, navigation, and how to provide feedback or contact issuing agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of the eCFR
rubrics_metrics.description: The Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) is the official legal print publication containing the codification of the general and permanent rules published in the Federal Register by the departments and agencies of the Federal Government. The Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) is a continuously updated online version of the CFR. It is not an official legal edition of the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the eCFR for up-to-date online access, but consult the official printed CFR (e.g., via govinfo.gov) for the official legal edition and cite the published CFR when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting the issuing agency for content questions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of the Federal Register publishes documents on behalf of Federal agencies but does not have any authority over their programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have questions for the Agency that issued the current document please contact the agency directly. For content feedback about the page, use the 'Content Feedback' button; for website issues use 'Website Feedback'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of published edition for citations
rubrics_metrics.description: View the most recent official publication: View Title 15 on govinfo.gov. These links go to the official, published CFR, which is updated annually. As a result, it may not include the most recent changes applied to the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an official published citation or archival reference is required, prefer the published CFR on govinfo.gov; be aware it may lag recent changes reflected in the eCFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigation and search behavior on the eCFR site
rubrics_metrics.description: Choosing an item from citations and headings will bring you directly to the content. Choosing an item from full text search results will bring you to those results. Pressing enter in the search box will also bring you to search results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search box, citation entry, or the listed parts/chapters to navigate directly to specific sections of Title 15. The page also offers features such as viewing historical versions, timelines, and a drafting site for amendatory language.
